Usage: helper [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

A made-up agent for Conductor's tests, its help in clap's form with no
blank line between its options.

Commands:
  login    Signs in
  help     Shows help

Options:
  -v, --version
          Prints the version
      --model <model>
          The model to use (use 'auto' to let it pick)
      --reasoning-effort <level>
          How hard it thinks [possible values: low, medium, high]
  -r, --resume [<value>]
          Goes on with a session (optionally named)
      --session-id <id>
          The session's id
      --allow-tool [<tools>...]
          Tools that run without a question
      --allow-all-tools
          Every tool runs without a question [env: HELPER_ALLOW_ALL=]
      --allow-all-paths
          Every path may be read and written
      --allow-all-urls
          Every address may be fetched
      --allow-all
          All of the three above
      --yolo
          All of the three above
  -C <directory>
          Changes to the folder first
      --add-dir <directory>
          Another folder it may use
  -h, --help
          Prints help

Help Topics:
  config       How settings are read
